name: counter-account
source:
# A counter: an account component that keeps a count in its storage and
# increments it by one on each call to `increment_count`.

use miden::protocol::active_account
use miden::protocol::native_account
use miden::core::sys

# STORAGE
# =================================================================================================

# The storage map that holds the count. A slot is named by a string: the
# account's storage knows it by this name, and the procedures below by the
# slot id the name hashes to, the first two felts of `word("…")`.
const COUNT_MAP_SLOT = word("counter_account::count_map")

# The map key the count is stored under.
const COUNT_KEY = [1, 0, 0, 0]

# PROCEDURES
# =================================================================================================

#! Returns the current count.
#!
#! Inputs:  [pad(16)]
#! Outputs: [count, pad(15)]
@account_procedure
proc get_count() -> felt
    push.COUNT_KEY push.COUNT_MAP_SLOT[0..2]
    # => [slot_id_suffix, slot_id_prefix, COUNT_KEY, pad(16)]

    exec.active_account::get_map_item
    # => [count, 0, 0, 0, pad(16)]

    # a procedure that is `call`ed must return 16 elements
    exec.sys::truncate_stack
    # => [count, pad(15)]
end

#! Increments the count by one and returns the new count.
#!
#! Inputs:  [pad(16)]
#! Outputs: [new_count, pad(15)]
@account_procedure
proc increment_count() -> felt
    push.COUNT_KEY push.COUNT_MAP_SLOT[0..2]
    exec.active_account::get_map_item
    # => [count, 0, 0, 0, pad(16)]

    add.1
    # => [new_count, 0, 0, 0, pad(16)]

    # keep a copy of the new count to return it
    dupw
    # => [new_count, 0, 0, 0, new_count, 0, 0, 0, pad(16)]

    push.COUNT_KEY push.COUNT_MAP_SLOT[0..2]
    # => [slot_id_suffix, slot_id_prefix, COUNT_KEY, new_count, 0, 0, 0, ...]

    exec.native_account::set_map_item
    # => [OLD_VALUE, new_count, 0, 0, 0, pad(16)]

    dropw
    # => [new_count, 0, 0, 0, pad(16)]

    exec.sys::truncate_stack
    # => [new_count, pad(15)]
end
